author: W. Stimpson, 1851

note.en: A tiny tube-shaped snail about 4 mm long that lives in shell sand; known here from INBio samples at 6 to 24 m off Manzanillo.
note.es: Un caracol diminuto en forma de tubo, de unos 4 mm, que vive en arena de conchas; conocido aquí por muestras del INBio entre 6 y 24 m frente a Manzanillo.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records for the region box (INBio Atta collection, iNaturalist)

recWhy: Record: GBIF: 4 museum specimens (INBio), Manzanillo, 1998 to 2000.
